{{Vanilla|Rabbit Stew}}
{{Hatnote|For the pack's leftover food built on the rabbit stew item, see [[Ramen]].}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Rabbit stew''' is the vanilla food, which [[Matcha Flavoured]] leaves almost untouched. The pack blocks the vanilla recipes that make it from a brown or red [[mushroom]], but not the recipe added in ''Minecraft'' 26.3 that uses a shelf mushroom, so that one still works.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref> It is unrelated to [[Ramen]], although both use the rabbit stew item.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A baked potato, [[Cooked Flesh|cooked flesh]] (the renamed cooked rabbit), a bowl, a carrot and a shelf mushroom, in any arrangement. A shelf mushroom drops from a shelf mushroom block, which grows on trees in swamps and dappled forests.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/worldgen/feature/swamp_oak.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/feature/red_poplar.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
The pack gives plain rabbit stew no healing of its own, unlike the foods it makes, and it has no effect.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.3|The shelf mushroom recipe from ''Minecraft'' 26.3 makes rabbit stew available again; the older rabbit stew recipes remain blocked.}}
}}
